setupNotes: Created empty frameworks/non-keyed directory required by the server discovery endpoint.
Root tooling installed with npm ci --legacy-peer-deps --ignore-scripts; server installed separately with npm ci.
Elm built with its installed compiler and the two upstream minification commands because elm-tooling is undeclared.

environment.browserExecutable: /private/tmp/foldkit-chrome-for-testing-156.0.8078.75/chrome-mac-arm64/Google Chrome for Testing.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome for Testing

implementationNotes: Random label generation runs in GenerateRows Command; update is pure.
Rows use h.keyed and createKeyedLazy({ evict: 'AbsentFromRender' }). Cached rows absent from a successful render are evicted.

sampling.order: CPU: entries run sequentially in upstream name order within each operation. Memory: seven isolated runners run concurrently, one entry per runner, with each runner processing its memory tests sequentially.
sampling.cpuMetric: Median total duration in milliseconds from upstream Chrome trace parsing.
sampling.memoryMetric: Median performance.measureUserAgentSpecificMemory().bytes divided by 1024^2, after forced major GC.

commands.cpu: PORT=8374 node dist/benchmarkRunner.js --framework keyed/vanillajs-lite keyed/solid keyed/react-hooks keyed/vue keyed/svelte keyed/elm keyed/foldkit --benchmark 01_ 02_ 03_ 04_ 05_ 06_ 07_ 08_ 09_ --count 15 --chromeBinary "$CHROME_BINARY"
